# 1. Data Fetching & Overview
```{r}
#| label: fetch-data

settings <- fetch_data_settings()
df_raw <- fetch_data_execution(settings)
fetch_data_exports(df_raw)

# data overview
glimpse(df_raw)
```

# 2. Data Cleaning & Integrity Checks
```{r}
#| label: data-quality

# data quality checks
df_raw %>% 
  summarise(
    total_rows = n(),
    distinct_ids = n_distinct(id),
    na_count = sum(is.na(df_raw))
  )
```

# 3. Univariate & Bivariate Analysis
```{r}
#| label: exploratory-plots
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# Univariate Analysis: Distribution of 'value'
df_raw %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Value", x = "Value", y = "Count")

# Bivariate Analysis: Value over Time
df_raw %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = timestamp, y = value)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Value Over Time", x = "Date / Time", y = "Value")

# Boxplot of 'value'
df_raw %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Outliers check", y = "Value")
```
